## LmdbEnv.onWarn() method

Attach a diagnostics listener.

**Signature:**

```typescript
onWarn(listener: (message: string) => void): void;
```

## Parameters

**Returns:**

void

## Remarks

The package writes nothing to `console`<!-- -->. With no listener attached its diagnostics are dropped, so attach one if you want to see `maxDbs` headroom warnings, CDC subscriber failures or failed scheduled ticks. Equivalent to the [ILmdbEnvOptions.onWarn](./lmdb.ilmdbenvoptions.onwarn.md) constructor option.

A listener that throws is contained — it cannot break a commit or a tick.

## Example


```typescript
env.onWarn((message) => logger.warn(message))
```
